It relies on a companion launcher to prepare necessary assets from an existing legitimate game installation.

Traditional Java-based Minecraft instances demand heavy memory allocation and frequent garbage collection, limiting performance on lower-end hardware and complicating programmatic interaction. - Executes core game mechanics, world generation, and redstone natively in Rust.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/horizon-rust/horizon.git

cargo run --release -p horizon-client
```

Systems programmers, Rust enthusiasts, and advanced server administrators looking to experiment with low-level game engine architecture or build automated agents inside a sandbox environment will find plenty to explore here.

Horizon is an extraordinary technical achievement backed by rigorous differential testing. While it continues to close remaining parity gaps against vanilla releases, it serves as a compelling glimpse into what is possible when modern systems languages meet classic game design.

Laya answers constrained questions (pick an option, score against a rubric, judge true or
false) with calibrated probabilities from one bidirectional forward pass. It generates no
tokens and returns no JSON to parse. This package runs the original
[Laya](https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya) weights in [MLX](https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx),
without PyTorch, Transformers or a cloud API.

**13.4 ms** median for a short English decision, **7.4 ms** with the multilingual checkpoint (M3 Max, FP16).
